name: eInTradePanel
summary: This is a trade panel utility EA that provides a graphical interface for manual trading operations. It delegates all functionality to the CIntegerTradePanel class, handling initialization, tick updates, timer events, and chart events to manage the panel's UI and user interactions.
summary_zh: 这是一个交易面板工具型EA，提供图形化界面用于手动交易操作。它将所有功能委托给CIntegerTradePanel类，处理初始化、行情更新、定时器事件和图表事件来管理面板的UI和用户交互。
strategy_analysis: 该EA本身不包含任何交易策略逻辑，它是一个纯粹的交易面板工具。所有的核心功能都封装在CIntegerTradePanel_2.mqh头文件中定义的CIntegerTradePanel类里。EA的入口函数OnInit调用TradePanel.Init()进行面板初始化，OnTick调用TradePanel.Tick()更新面板状态，OnTimer调用TradePanel.Timer()处理定时任务，OnChartEvent调用TradePanel.ChartEvent()处理用户的界面交互事件如按钮点击和输入框操作。由于策略逻辑完全隐藏在包含文件中，无法从主文件判断具体的交易执行方式、仓位管理和资金管理细节。该EA本质上是一个半自动化交易辅助工具，依赖交易员通过面板手动决策。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA does not contain any trading strategy logic itself; it is a pure trade panel utility. All core functionality is encapsulated in the CIntegerTradePanel class defined in the CIntegerTradePanel_2.mqh header file. The OnInit entry calls TradePanel.Init() for panel initialization, OnTick calls TradePanel.Tick() to update panel state, OnTimer calls TradePanel.Timer() for timed tasks, and OnChartEvent calls TradePanel.ChartEvent() to handle user interface interactions such as button clicks and input operations. Since the strategy logic is entirely hidden within the include file, the specific trade execution method, position sizing, and money management details cannot be determined from the main file alone. The EA is essentially a semi-automated trading assistant tool that relies on the trader making manual decisions through the panel interface.

parameters.name: Include Library
parameters.description: 包含的核心面板类库文件
parameters.description_en: Included core panel class library file

pros: 架构简洁清晰，主文件仅作为事件分发器，职责单一
核心逻辑封装在独立类库中，便于维护和版本更新
完整覆盖MQL5所有事件处理函数，确保面板响应及时
模块化设计便于复用，可轻松集成到其他EA中
pros_en: Clean and minimal architecture with the main file acting solely as an event dispatcher with single responsibility
Core logic encapsulated in a separate class library, facilitating maintenance and version updates
Comprehensive coverage of all MQL5 event handler functions ensuring responsive panel behavior
Modular design enables easy reuse and integration into other EAs
cons: 核心逻辑完全隐藏在包含文件中，无法从主文件审计交易行为和风险管理
缺少输入参数，用户无法在不修改代码的情况下自定义面板行为
没有错误处理机制，OnInit返回0而非INIT_SUCCEEDED常量，且未检查Init()调用结果
无法判断面板是否支持止损止盈设置等风险控制功能
cons_en: Core logic is entirely hidden in the include file, making it impossible to audit trading behavior and risk management from the main file
No input parameters exposed, preventing users from customizing panel behavior without code modification
No error handling mechanism; OnInit returns 0 instead of INIT_SUCCEEDED constant and does not check Init() return value
Impossible to determine whether the panel supports risk control features like stop-loss and take-profit settings
improvements: 将关键配置参数暴露为input变量，如面板位置、默认手数、滑点和止损设置等
在OnInit中添加TradePanel.Init()的返回值检查，失败时返回INIT_FAILED并记录错误日志
使用INIT_SUCCEEDED和INIT_FAILED常量替代硬编码的0和-1返回值
improvements_en: Expose key configuration parameters as input variables such as panel position, default lot size, slippage, and stop-loss settings
Add return value checking for TradePanel.Init() in OnInit, returning INIT_FAILED and logging errors on failure
Use INIT_SUCCEEDED and INIT_FAILED constants instead of hardcoded 0 and -1 return values

risk_points: 面板本身不自动开仓，风险取决于交易员手动操作
无法确认面板是否强制要求设置止损止盈，存在人为操作失误风险
包含文件中的逻辑未经审计，可能存在未知的交易执行问题
risk_points_en: The panel itself does not open positions automatically; risk depends entirely on manual trader operations
Cannot confirm whether the panel enforces stop-loss and take-profit settings, posing human error risk
The logic in the include file is unaudited and may contain unknown trade execution issues
